description: Retrieve licence facts for one Hugging Face dataset: declared licence, where it was declared, recorded source datasets, detected licence files and a signal. Each licence value comes with an evidence URL linking to the Hub file, API record, file list or Hub page that was checked, with a commit-specific link where available. For datasets in the daily build, facts come from the build by default. Other public datasets are checked live on the Hugging Face Hub. Signal values: permissive = permissive or share-alike licence reported; restrictive = use restrictions reported; conflict = possible licence conflict; unclear = insufficient or unrecognised licence information. These signals do not establish permission to use a dataset. Licence facts reported by the dataset and its declared sources. Not legal advice, and not a grant of permission to use the dataset.

live.description: Check the Hub now instead of using the facts published by the daily build. Datasets not in the build are always checked live.

name: dataset_licence
